shared_elements: upright carved stone slab as the support
low-relief carving on a flat face
register of repeated small motifs along a band
justification: Both are tall upright stone slabs bearing low-relief carving organised into stacked horizontal registers, with profile animal figures and a small anthropomorphic figure among them, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ sharply: A is a coarse, sparse, outline-incised rendering of isolated creatures on a weathered rough block, while B is a densely worked, framed composition with continuous interlace borders and a shaped, mushroom-like outline, implying an entirely different carving manner and design logic.
